title: Spirited Away
comment: Studio Ghibli's masterpiece. The visual storytelling, magical world, and beautiful soundtrack make it an absolute work of art.

title: Howl's Moving Castle
comment: A gorgeous fantasy romance. The theme of self-worth and Ghibli's anti-war message are woven beautifully together.

title: Inception
comment: Mind-bending dream heist concept with incredible practical effects, stellar editing, and a gripping score.

title: Nope
comment: Jordan Peele's spectacular take on sci-fi spectacle and humanity's obsession with documenting the unexplained. Highly atmospheric.
